title: Proxy normalization harness: smoke contract + golden-prompt oracle for streaming & toolcalls
creator: Aisha Khatri
description: Build a lightweight proxy-layer test harness that normalizes differences between streaming protocols and function-call semantics across model backends, and run a smoke contract suite using a curated golden-prompt oracle. The goal is to detect regressions introduced by kernel/runtime changes, model shims, or translation layers before they hit customers. This ticket covers: 1) a proxy adapter that can replay/translate NDJSON vs chunked-stream differences and canonicalize function-call events, 2) a golden-prompt corpus and expected fingerprint manifest for deterministic checks, 3) CI smoke tests that run the harness against canaries (hosted + dedicated) and fail build on drift above threshold, and 4) a small regression dashboard summarizing diffs and examples for triage.
acceptance_criteria: Proxy adapter can accept streaming output from at least three providers (native-hosted, dedicated runtime, and private shim) and produce a canonical event stream
Function-call translation layer normalizes name/arg ordering and stable id mapping so toolcall replay is deterministic
Golden-prompt corpus (>= 60 prompts) with expected normalized fingerprints stored in S3 and referenced by CI
CI job that runs the smoke contract on every runtime-2.3 branch build and fails on >2% token-level structural drift or any missing toolcall events
Regression dashboard created (internal URL) that lists top 10 failing prompts with raw vs canonicalized outputs and suggested triage labels
test_plan: Create proxy adapter service with two modes: record (captures raw stream + metadata) and normalize (replays canonical events)
Assemble golden-prompt corpus: edge streaming (partial chunks), nested JSON, interrupted functioncall sequences, backpressure scenarios
Implement deterministic fingerprint: canonicalized JSON ordering, whitespace normalization, truncation-invariant hash
CI pipeline: job runs normalized harness against canary endpoints (hosted, dedicated-canary, private-stub). Store results artifact and publish to dashboard
Alerting: create ci/regression label + Slack report when new prompt drifts beyond threshold; include link to recorded raw stream for debugging
implementation_notes: Prefer non-blocking Node adapter for proxy to match runtime behavior; Go shim optional for performance tests
Normalization rules: sort object keys except for arrays, normalize timestamp formats, remap ephemeral ids to stable placeholders
For function-calls, canonical form should include: function name, canonical arg map (sorted keys), call_id placeholder, and call lifecycle events (start, partial, end)
Golden corpus stored: s3://rw-golden/prompts/proxy-oracle/2026-03-01 and versioned via manifest.json
PRs should include recorded raw artifacts (ndjson) and the normalized fingerprint to make reviews deterministic
